title: CoStar Group management to meet with JMP Securities CSGP - The Fly
text:
Italian GDP deficit target concerns market » Stock futures are trading…
Stock futures are trading lower as the European markets react to Italy's deficit/GDP target of 2.4%, which raises concern about its trajectory. Of noted interest in the U.S. will be the Senate Judiciary Committee vote on Supreme Court nominee Brett Kavanaugh early this morning. The economic calendar has several reports scheduled for release, including personal income and spending reports, the Chicago Purchasing Manager's report, and the University of Michigan consumer confidence reading. In early pre-market trading, Dow futures are 70 points below fair value, Nasdaq futures are 27 points below fair value and S&P futures are 7 points below fair value. AAPL
